pathAssistantSteps.info:
Lost renewal - record the reason (every team, no exceptions). Most renewal losses are No-fault cancellation, Budget, or engagement.

  • Primary Reason
  • Sub-reason
  • A one-line Note

This is how we track and fix churn.
Renewed. Set by Finance approval once the Pending Approval stage is approved.

Signed - Finance approving. Not won yet (still open).

  • Signed contract attached; Finance reviews for approval
  • Sales to AM hand-off complete; onboarding and CEP initiated
  • Named users and ROI measures confirmed

Renewal contract is with the customer to sign.

  • Contract issued for signature
  • Buyer signs and returns the contract
  • PO received if applicable. Contract Attached is set automatically once the contract or quote document is on the opportunity

Renewal entry point. The customer is reviewing the renewal.

  • Budget approved or terms in review; ROI and usage demonstrated
  • Renewal quote shared and acknowledged
  • Closing call scheduled and accepted (or jump straight to Contract Out)

Known renewal - do not park here. Renewals win about 50% and retain ~87% by value - start at Evaluate, not Identify.

  • Confirm the account is renewing
  • Existing contract and usage reviewed
  • Set Forecast Status (health) and advance promptly

Yes, subject to terms.

  • Customer happy with final proposal; gives verbal or written go-ahead to send the contract
  • Legal and Finance terms approved internally

Confirm renewal intent. Renewals are lost mostly to no-fault cancellation, budget and engagement - protect those:

  • Customer confirms the product still solves their need - show usage and ROI
  • Budget and economic buyer confirmed
  • Renewal quote requested or proposal due
  • Forecast Status reflects current health

Do not leave renewals at 10-20% - advance promptly.
